passage:
**Jeepney trips from the terminal to city hall**

| Trip | Leaves terminal | Arrives at city hall |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1st | 6:00 a.m. | 6:45 a.m. |
| 2nd | 6:30 a.m. | 7:15 a.m. |
| 3rd | 7:15 a.m. | 8:05 a.m. |
| 4th | 8:00 a.m. | 8:45 a.m. |
stem: Which trip leaves the terminal at 7:15 a.m.?
hints: This time you know the time and need the trip. Look in the "Leaves terminal" column.
Go down the "Leaves terminal" column until you find 7:15 a.m.
When you find 7:15 a.m. in that column, look at the start of its row to see which trip it is.

solution.methodName: Find the value in the right column, then read the row

steps.why: 7:15 a.m. appears twice in the table. Only one of them is a leaving time.

steps.action: Go down that column to 7:15 a.m.
Read the trip at the start of that row: 3rd.
The 3rd trip leaves the terminal at 7:15 a.m.

trapNotes.2nd trip: The 2nd trip arrives at city hall at 7:15 a.m. The question asks which trip leaves at 7:15 a.m.
trapNotes.1st trip: The 1st trip leaves at 6:00 a.m. Look for 7:15 a.m. in the "Leaves terminal" column.
trapNotes.4th trip: The 4th trip leaves at 8:00 a.m. Look for 7:15 a.m. in the "Leaves terminal" column.
